name: S-seeded products — S1 Actuation
description: Whole-first wave-1 corpus artifact for the Actuation product corpus, seeded from the essay's S1 record (L1 Causal / L4′ Scientific; movement 38 of §5). The whole path is S1's own movement structure #0 → #5→0, read from the authored bytes at Antykathera-Essay-Work 7d96ada2. Each scene binds the S1 record (path + sha256) and one material record from the frozen P1-census-actuation inventory (6 of 157 records; every bound record byte-identical to EpiLogos/Actuation origin/main 36bbf93b7, verified 2026-09-21). Admission: the S register (T25 census, register episteme). Scene texts compress and quote the records, never invent claims; tints, formations and layout are declared craft (profiles/s-products-corpus-base). Wave-1 slice, not corpus-complete.

scenes.name: An internality articulates itself
scenes.character: Actuation is the living articulation of an internality: its event-substance — perceiving, differentiating, speaking, acting, with authority, delegation and composition as developed organisations of that articulation.

text.title: An internality articulates itself
text.italic: Actuation is the living articulation of an internality.

scenes.name: From freedom into an event — L1 Causal
scenes.character: Svātantrya, Material, Efficient, Formal, Final, Will: a delegated act can retain genuine judgment while remaining accountable to its commission; a false premise can require reformulating the question.

text.title: From freedom into an event — L1 Causal

scenes.name: An act becoming knowledge — L4′ Scientific
scenes.character: Prompts, Traces, Challenges, Patterns, Discovery, Insight: traces retain what actually happened; challenges bring contrary evidence into the inquiry; discovery changes what the next act begins from.

text.title: An act becoming knowledge — L4′ Scientific

scenes.name: A world of possible judgments
scenes.character: A distribution over candidates and the candidate selected from it have different work; J-Space remains a bounded articulation of world-for-agency, not the agent’s world in total.

scenes.name: Actuation’s local constitution and return
scenes.character: S1/P0–P5: agent and agency, world binding and composition, authority and delegation, the determination stream, execution, and the return of attribution, recognition and world-mutation.

scenes.name: Returned judgment and its retained model depth
scenes.character: Returned judgment keeps its exact technical conditions recoverable: mathematics, exclusion, J-Space and preference retain their separate operations within the act.
